sites.enforcement_snippet:
if actor.role != "admin":
    raise PermissionDeniedError(f"User {actor.id} is not an admin")

domain_notes: remove_member is guarded by a single admin-role check before it mutates org.members. Both existing tests pass an actor with role 'admin'; neither constructs a non-admin actor, so the guard's rejection path is never exercised.
rationale: Selected remove_member because its admin-role check is the sole enforcement of the requirement and no test drives a non-admin actor.
